resources.string: Tap to choose a photo from your gallery
Photo logging needs internet — you can log manually.
Menosan suggests the item details from your photo. AI suggestions can be wrong, so you\'ll check them before saving. Your photo isn\'t stored.
Tip: one kind of item per photo, in good light, works best.
Identifying your item to help you log your waste
This is taking a little longer. The server may be waking up, which can take up to a minute.
Photo logging needs internet. Check your connection and try again, or log this item manually.
Try a closer photo of the item on a plain surface, or log it manually.
This happens sometimes. Try again, or use a clearer photo. You can always log it manually.
Please try a different photo, or log the item manually.
You can scan again tomorrow. Logging manually works anytime.
You can scan again on %1$s. Logging manually works anytime.
Please try a different photo, or log the item manually.
Check your connection and try again. If this keeps happening, log out and sign in again from Profile.
Please choose a different photo (JPEG or PNG works best), or log the item manually.
You can choose a photo from your gallery instead, or log the item manually.
Please try again in a moment, or log the item manually.
Fields marked \"AI suggestion\" came from your photo. Edit them, or tap the chip to keep a value as is.
Please check the details and tick the box to save.
Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.
Entry saved. Thanks for checking the details!
